ResearchProjectDef.label: Invader mechs
ResearchProjectDef.description: Gestate berserker, bombardier, constrictor, infiltrator and templar mechanoids.

ResearchProjectDef.label: System interlink
ResearchProjectDef.description: Build a mechlink upgrade which allows the mechanitor to interface with a mechanoid to boost its performance and reduce incoming damage. The user psychically links with their target, using their own brain as a backup for critical subsystems.
